result.instructions: Tools for Reservio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which free slots do we have for a haircut next Tuesday?"; "List the bookings created in the last 24 hours."; "Which staff members work on Friday, and what are their rosters?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Reservio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run reservio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run reservio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run reservio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. reservio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: reservio_get_business
tools.title: Get a business
tools.description: Get the business profile: name, address, contact details, time zone. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.

tools.name: reservio_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services clients can book, with duration, price and capacity. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/services.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.

sort.description: Sort column, prefix - for descending, e.g. -createdAt.

filter.description: Filters as {"name": "Bob"}; each key becomes filter[key]=value (JSON:API).

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for paging.

tools.name: reservio_get_booking_slots
tools.title: Get free booking slots
tools.description: List free time slots for a service in a date range, optionally for one resource. Use before creating a booking. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/availability/booking-slots.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.

resource_id.description: Limit to one resource (staff member), from reservio_list_resources.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.

resource_id.description: Limit to one resource (staff member), from reservio_list_resources.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.

resource_id.description: Limit to one resource (staff member), from reservio_list_resources.

tools.name: reservio_create_appointment_booking
tools.title: Create an appointment booking
tools.description: WRITE: create a real appointment booking for a service at a start/end time (use a slot from reservio_get_booking_slots). Reservio may notify the client. Not safe to repeat: a second call books a second appointment. Reservio API: POST /businesses/{businessId}/bookings.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.

tools.name: reservio_create_group_booking
tools.title: Book a group event
tools.description: WRITE: book a client into an existing group event (event id from reservio_list_events). Reservio may notify the client. Not safe to repeat: a second call books a second seat. Reservio API: POST /businesses/{businessId}/bookings.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Reservio
prompts.description: What you can do with Reservio here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_open_slots_for_a_service_next_week
prompts.title: Find open slots for a service next week
prompts.description: Pick a service and a date range. See which days have an open slot and the exact start times, for all staff or for one person.

prompts.name: poll_for_the_newest_bookings
prompts.title: Poll for the newest bookings
prompts.description: List the bookings sorted by creation time, newest first. Read the client name, state and cost of each one to spot new bookings.

prompts.name: check_who_works_on_a_given_day
prompts.title: Check who works on a given day
prompts.description: Read the staff members and their rosters for a date. Compare them with the opening hours of the business.

prompts.name: book_a_client_into_an_open_appointment_slot
prompts.title: Book a client into an open appointment slot
prompts.description: Find an open slot for a service, then create the appointment booking for the client. Reservio may notify the client.

prompts.name: add_a_client_to_a_group_event
prompts.title: Add a client to a group event
prompts.description: Find the days with open group events, pick the event and book the client into it. Reservio may notify the client.
